name: listdetail
need: Show a list, the detail of what is picked and a sub-detail as columns that fold to one with a back button on phones

--ds-listdetail-height.description: list-detail layout: its height (a length where the parent grows with its content)

--ds-listdetail-list-width.description: list-detail layout: the list column beside the detail

--ds-listdetail-detail-min.description: list-detail layout: the narrowest the detail gets beside another column; the list and the detail fold to one column below the list's width plus this

--ds-listdetail-sub-width.description: list-detail layout: the sub-detail column beside the detail

--ds-listdetail-line.description: list-detail layout: the hairlines between the columns and under a head

--ds-listdetail-head-height.description: `.ds-listdetail__head` at the comfortable density, 4px less per step (`.ds-touch`: at least the touch target)

--ds-listdetail-padding.description: `.ds-listdetail__head` (its sides) and `.ds-listdetail__body`: the padding, 2px less per density step
